key: ONYX SHUTTER UNLOCKED
en: ONYX SHUTTER UNLOCKED
ja: オニキスシャッター解除

key: TITANIA: What is it now?
en: TITANIA: What is it now?
ja: ティタニア: 今度は何?

key: TAKA: Oh, no...
en: TAKA: Oh, no...
ja: タカ: ああ、まずいな……

key: The water level drops and leaves you stranded and apart...
en: The water level drops and leaves you stranded and apart...
ja: 水位が下がって、離れ離れになって取り残される……

key: What ever will you do now?
en: What ever will you do now?
ja: さて、どうする気だい?

key: TITANIA: Stick around and find out.
en: TITANIA: Stick around and find out.
ja: ティタニア: このまま様子を見ればいいでしょ。

key: TAKA: You know, I don't think I will.
en: TAKA: You know, I don't think I will.
ja: タカ: うーん、それはやめとくよ。

key: TITANIA: So, you're the new commander those others mentioned?
en: TITANIA: So, you're the new commander those others mentioned?
ja: ティタニア: あんたが、みんなが言ってた新しい司令官?

key: TAKA: I dunno if I'm much of a commander per se, but that's sort of what I'm doing down here I guess.
en: TAKA: I dunno if I'm much of a commander per se, but that's sort of what I'm doing down here I guess.
ja: タカ: 自分が司令官って柄かどうかは分からないけど、ここでやってることはまあそんな感じかな。

key: TITANIA: Uh huh.
en: TITANIA: Uh huh.
ja: ティタニア: ふーん。

key: And what do you want?
en: And what do you want?
ja: それで、何が目的なの?

key: TAKA: Want?
en: TAKA: Want?
ja: タカ: 目的?

key: I'm just following orders.
en: I'm just following orders.
ja: 僕はただ命令に従ってるだけだよ。

key: TITANIA: That's what the other guy said.
en: TITANIA: That's what the other guy said.
ja: ティタニア: さっきの男も同じこと言ってたわね。

key: Didn't work out so hot for him.
en: Didn't work out so hot for him.
ja: あいつはうまくいかなかったけど。

key: What do you accomplish by letting us in here in the first place?
en: What do you accomplish by letting us in here in the first place?
ja: そもそも、あたしたちをここに入れて、何を成し遂げるつもりなの?

key: You could have just kept us locked in the landing and made off with Amaria and the Sapphire Bracelets already.
en: You could have just kept us locked in the landing and made off with Amaria and the Sapphire Bracelets already.
ja: あたしたちを入り口に閉じ込めたまま、アマリアとサファイアのブレスレットを持ち去ることだってできたはずでしょ。

key: But there's a reason you haven't.
en: But there's a reason you haven't.
ja: でも、そうしなかった。何か理由があるはずよ。

key: Tell me it.
en: Tell me it.
ja: 教えなさい。

key: TAKA: So many questions and demands...
en: TAKA: So many questions and demands...
ja: タカ: 質問も要求も多いなぁ……

key: Are you really in a place for that?
en: Are you really in a place for that?
ja: 今、それを言える立場だと思ってるの?

key: TITANIA: Stop avoiding the subject.
en: TITANIA: Stop avoiding the subject.
ja: ティタニア: 話をそらすのはやめて。

key: Answer me.
en: Answer me.
ja: 答えなさい。

key: TAKA: Yeaaah, I don't think I will.
en: TAKA: Yeaaah, I don't think I will.
ja: タカ: いやぁ、それはやめとくよ。

key: I mean, why would I give that information to the people who are supposed to be my enemies?
en: I mean, why would I give that information to the people who are supposed to be my enemies?
ja: だって、なんで敵になるはずの相手にそんな情報を教えないといけないの?

key: TITANIA: Tch. Don't act like your precious little team is that good at keeping secrets anyway.
en: TITANIA: Tch. Don't act like your precious little team is that good at keeping secrets anyway.
ja: ティタニア: チッ。あんたの大事なチームが、秘密を守るのがそんなに得意だなんて思わないほうがいいわよ。

key: I've been trading information with your grunts for months,
en: I've been trading information with your grunts for months,
ja: もう何ヶ月も、あんたのところの下っ端たちと情報のやり取りをしてきたの。

key: And misleading them every step of the way.
en: And misleading them every step of the way.
ja: それで、毎回ちゃんと連中を欺いてきたわ。

key: I got a little more practice with lying than I'd like.
en: I got a little more practice with lying than I'd like.
ja: おかげで、望んでもいないのにうそをつくのがうまくなっちゃった。

key: But that's the thing about a group of people who are just using each other.
en: But that's the thing about a group of people who are just using each other.
ja: でも、それがお互いを利用し合ってるだけの集団ってものよ。

key: They're easy to exploit.
en: They're easy to exploit.
ja: 簡単に付け込めるの。

key: And you're no different.
en: And you're no different.
ja: あんたも例外じゃないわ。

key: TAKA: I mean, whatever you say.
en: TAKA: I mean, whatever you say.
ja: タカ: まあ、何とでも言ってよ。

key: At the end of the day, you're stuck over there now, and I have an operation to manage.
en: At the end of the day, you're stuck over there now, and I have an operation to manage.
ja: 結局、あんたはそっちに閉じ込められたままだし、僕には管理しなきゃいけない作戦があるんだ。

key: So if it's cool, I'm gonna go do that.
en: So if it's cool, I'm gonna go do that.
ja: だからよかったら、そっちをやりに行くよ。

key: See ya.
en: See ya.
ja: じゃあね。

key: TITANIA: And you just run away.
en: TITANIA: And you just run away.
ja: ティタニア: そのまま逃げるってわけ。

key: Truly an upstanding agent.
en: Truly an upstanding agent.
ja: ほんと、立派なエージェントだこと。

key: What a shame that Team Meteor does not have more men of your caliber.
en: What a shame that Team Meteor does not have more men of your caliber.
ja: チームメテオに、あんたほどの人材がもっといないのが残念ね。

key: Anyway, this is annoying. You wanna see if you can get me off of this?
en: Anyway, this is annoying. You wanna see if you can get me off of this?
ja: まあいいわ、これじゃ面倒だから。あたしをここから出せそう?

key: I'd appreciate it. Just a little bit.
en: I'd appreciate it. Just a little bit.
ja: 助かるわ。少しでいいから。

key: We will faithfully serve the new order, be it in life or death.
en: We will faithfully serve the new order, be it in life or death.
ja: 我々は新たな秩序に、生きても死んでも忠実に仕えよう。

key: You may take my life, but my soul forever remains with Arceus.
en: You may take my life, but my soul forever remains with Arceus.
ja: ケイデン: 私の命は奪えても、私の魂は永遠にアルセウスとともにある。

key: My present duty is fulfilled. You shall be bothered by me no longer.
en: My present duty is fulfilled. You shall be bothered by me no longer.
ja: 今の私の務めは果たされた。もう二度と、私があなたを煩わせることはない。

key: TITANIA: After you, scout.
en: TITANIA: After you, scout.
ja: ティタニア: お先にどうぞ、斥候さん。
